moment: Blood-red sunset over a lone homestead and corral, crows overhead (Beecher's Hope / end-of-trail ranch feel)
why: Crimson-graded western ranch, rail fence, big oak, crows and Rockies-style range read as the Red Dead palette; the four pink X markers on a line look like Dead Eye tags.

moment: The Great Hall at Hogwarts, empty, before a feast
why: Four long house tables, raised staff table, tall gothic windows and floating candles are unmistakable.

moment: Night sea with a tall ship on the horizon; Jack Sparrow-style compass
why: Square-rigged ship at night plus an ornate brass compass; the glowing teal wave also nods to Sea of Thieves, so not certain which.

moment: Final scene at Pangong Lake, Ladakh, the yellow scooter
why: Mirror-still high-altitude lake with bare brown mountains and a lone yellow scooter on the shingle is the 3 Idiots ending postcard.

moment: Hogwarts castle across the Black Lake at night, broomstick and floating candles
why: Spired castle on a cliff over black water, a broom and floating candles; no ambiguity.

moment: Engineering-college classroom blackboard with a quadcopter sketch
why: Chalk drone suggests the 3 Idiots drone subplot, but the Romanesque arched window could equally be a Hogwarts classroom; weak cue.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct
why: Red steam engine on the curved Highland viaduct beside a loch is the iconic Hogwarts Express shot.

moment: Imperial College of Engineering lecture hall, drone drawn on the board
why: Exposed-stone, concrete-colonnade Indian campus lecture theatre with wooden benches and a chalk quadcopter fits 3 Idiots (shot at IIM campus).

moment: Ship on the horizon at night, compass bobbing in the swell
why: Same as J003: tall ship plus brass compass; bioluminescent wave could also be Sea of Thieves.

moment: Ship sailing into the sunset; treasure-map route from compass to X with a skull medallion
why: Dotted treasure route, X marks the spot, skull token and Jack's compass are classic Pirates iconography.

moment: The Black Pearl with tattered black sails emerging from fog by moonlight
why: Ragged black sails, lantern-lit stern galleries, storm clouds and moon: the Curse of the Black Pearl look.

moment: Floating candles beneath the Great Hall's enchanted night-sky ceiling
why: Hovering lit candles against a starfield is the enchanted ceiling.

moment: The Black Pearl with Jack Sparrow's compass overlaid
why: Same black-sailed ship plus the octagonal brass compass.

moment: The Great Hall at Hogwarts with hundreds of floating candles
why: Same Great Hall composition, more candles.

moment: Virus's astronaut pen in its velvet case beside his stopwatch
why: A ceremonial pen in a box next to a pocket watch, in a classroom, matches the director's 'space pen' handed to the best student and his obsession with time; would not be readable to someone who hasn't seen the film.

moment: A page of Arthur Morgan's sketch journal: horse, pines, lake, taped note
why: Pencil sketches of a saddled horse, pines and a lake on cream paper with a taped note is the RDR2 journal style.

moment: Black Pearl in shadow, compass needle above a dotted vertical route
why: Ship silhouette plus the brass compass and waypoints.

moment: Gang camp at dusk: canvas tent with lantern, stew pot over fire, wagon
why: Wall tent, chuck wagon wheel, pot on a tripod and Rockies at dusk evoke the Van der Linde camp.

moment: Dead Eye: red sky over the ranch with X marks painted on targets
why: Red-tinted landscape plus X tags on the crows is a direct Dead Eye targeting reference.

moment: Floating candles in a night sky with broom-tail streaks
why: Candles read Hogwarts; the bristled line ends look like broomstick tails or quill strokes.

moment: Port Royal harbour by moonlight; map from compass to X past an Aztec-style sun medallion
why: Colonial harbour with tall ships at night and the Aztec-gold-style medallion on the route.

moment: The Marauder's Map unfolded, before the ink appears
why: Folded parchment panels, compass-rose seals and hand-drawn corridor outlines; could also be a generic treasure map.

moment: Virus's pen in its case and his pocket watch
why: Same as J015.

moment: Arthur's journal page with a crossed-out sketch and a red underline
why: Same journal style as J016.

moment: The Marauder's Map on a candlelit floor, footprints walking across it
why: Moving footprints on parchment under floating candles with a castle window is the Marauder's Map.

moment: Golden-hour valley with a river and a lone grazing horse
why: Painterly western vista with a horse fits RDR2 scenery but is generic.

moment: Lecture hall, quadcopter and formula sketched on the blackboard
why: Same lecture hall as J008.

moment: Sunrise over a river valley, horse grazing under an oak
why: Same as J026, full-bleed.

moment: The Marauder's Map with footprints walking the corridors
why: Ink footprints moving along hand-drawn corridors on folded parchment.

moment: Storm at sea; treasure route from compass to X past a skull
why: Same map motif as J010 with stormy water.

moment: Night camp, two tents around a fire
why: Frontier campfire mood; generic on its own.

moment: The gang camp at sunset: horses at the hitching rail, covered wagon, tents, cook pot
why: Hitching rail with horses, prairie schooner, wall tents and stew pot by a lake is the RDR2 camp almost exactly.

moment: Wanted posters nailed to a wooden board
why: Aged posters tacked to planks evoke the RDR wanted-poster board; also generic western.

moment: Floating candles; one candle targeted by a teal reticle
why: Floating candles against a starry ceiling; the bracket feels like a game UI overlay.

moment: Homemade quadcopter flying across the college courtyard
why: Exposed-brick and concrete Indian campus plus a DIY drone recalls the 3 Idiots drone; could equally be just an engineering student's photo.

moment: Quadcopter hovering past the campus colonnade
why: Same as J035.

moment: Pangong Lake at sunset, yellow scooter circled and ticked
why: Same postcard as J004 with sun on the water; the circle-and-tick pins it as the destination.
